You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: The module specifies a nondeterministic quicksort algorithm operating on an array of natural numbers, expressed as a PlusCal macro-based algorithm translated into TLA+.

The single constant `N` determines the array length. The variables are `Ainit` (the initial array, chosen nondeterministically from all functions `1..N → 1..N`), `A` (the working array), `S` (a set of index-range pairs representing subranges still to be sorted), `pivot` (the most recently chosen pivot index), and `pc` (the program counter).

Initially, `A` equals `Ainit` and `S` contains the single interval `⟨1, N⟩`. The single action `qs1` repeatedly picks an unsorted subrange `I` from `S`. If the subrange has more than one element, it nondeterministically selects a pivot index `piv` within the range, then nondeterministically rearranges `A` to any permutation that leaves elements outside `[I[1], I[2]]` unchanged and ensures every element on the left of the pivot is at most every element on the right. The subrange is then replaced by the two sub-intervals on either side of the pivot. If the subrange is a singleton, it is simply removed. The algorithm terminates when `S` is empty.

The temporal specification `Spec` is `Init ∧ [][Next]_vars` with weak fairness on `Next`. The configuration checks the liveness property `Termination` (`<>(pc = "Done")`), asserting that sorting always completes, with `N = 4`. No explicit sorting-correctness safety invariant is included in the module.
